messages:
deploy-bot: preflight failed for staging/alert-bridge chart v3.0.0 -> values-schema validation error: unknown field 'legacy.alertsEnabled'
emily: ahh v3 removed legacy.alertsEnabled and replaced with alerts.enabled boolean. our staging overlay still sets legacy.alertsEnabled: true
rick: that explains why the helm hooks that create legacy CRs didn't run in canary, pods come up but controllers error out
laura: options: 1) patch staging overlay to set alerts.enabled=true and remove legacy key, 2) pin to chart v2.9.8 for this window, or 3) manual canary with chart v3.0.0 + compat shim ConfigMap that maps legacy -> new key at render time
ops-oncall: payroll deploy in 40m. we should avoid cross-team churn. pinning to 2.9.8 buys us time
emily: pin is simplest but we lose the v3 fixes. hotpatching overlay to set alerts.enabled=true is quick too and preserves v3 templates; only worry is any other breaking defaults in v3
rick: if we hotpatch, do `helm upgrade --set alerts.enabled=true --namespace staging alert-bridge redwood/alert-bridge --version 3.0.0 --reuse-values --dry-run --debug` then promote canary
laura: also check chart notes for migration steps. I saw a migration job added in v3 that only runs when `migrateLegacyCRs: true` is set. we don't want auto-migrate in staging unless we plan it
sam: I'd prefer hotpatch with migrateLegacyCRs=false then do a manual migration in maintenance window. avoids accidental double-migrate in prod
emily: agreed. will prepare a minimal values override: `alerts: { enabled: true }, migrateLegacyCRs: false` and push a tiny commit to infra-values repo
release-manager: do it, run canary, if green sign off and we'll keep pin plan as rollback fallback. update release notes: note that v3 requires values schema migration and we applied a temporary override in staging
ops-oncall: once canary is green, I'll notify payroll team and confirm window remains safe
emily: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/ef12b9d -- title: staging: adapt to alert-bridge v3 values schema (temporary override)
rick: deploy-bot, re-run canary on that commit? tagging @deploy-bot promote canary
deploy-bot: acknowledged. manual canary triggered for staging on commit ef12b9d. will report back results in ~6m
laura: post-action checklist: 1) create ticket to reconcile staging overlays before the next chart bump, 2) add migration steps to chart README, 3) consider lint rule to fail PRs that add legacy keys against v3
release-manager: good. if canary fails, we revert to pin v2.9.8 and open an incident for cross-team coordination on migrations
ops-oncall: monitoring check list: watch controller errors, pod restarts, and any crashloop backoff. I'll keep an eye and alert if anything spikes
deploy-bot: canary succeeded: 2/2 healthy after 5m, no regressions observed
emily: great, proceeding to sign-off and leaving the staging override in place until we schedule migration ticket
release-manager: thanks. I'll add a brief blurb to release notes and close the loop.
